designationHistory.name: Modoc Forest Reserve
designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt proclaimed the Modoc Forest Reserve in California.
designationHistory.note: UCSB's '535' is the American Presidency Project's own document number; the Statutes at Large print this as proclamation No. 37 of the 58th Congress.

sources.name: Proclamation of Nov. 29, 1904, 33 Stat. 2380 (govinfo, Statutes at Large)

designationHistory.name: Modoc National Forest
designationHistory.indexText: Congress provided that forest reserves would be known as national forests, so the Modoc Forest Reserve became the Modoc National Forest.
designationHistory.note: Approved by President Theodore Roosevelt at 9:43 a.m. on Mar. 4, 1907 (the act's approval line). Mar. 4, 1907 was not an inauguration day.
